implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/dlq/RetryAttemptsPanel.tsx: Expandable panel per DLQ entry. Shows all retry attempts as a timeline list (chronological, oldest first). Each attempt: attempt number, timestamp, error message (in code block), duration. Visual: progress dots or numbered steps. Indicator: X of maxRetries attempts used (ProgressBar component).
implementationPlan.note: Created RetryAttemptsPanel component with: timeline UI (numbered dots with connecting line), per-attempt timestamp + error in pre/code block, duration between attempts, retry count vs max with ProgressBar (color-coded: default/warning/danger).
